basic_info.description: Experience breathtaking views from this beautifully updated mid-century two-bedroom, two-bath condominium in Diamond Heights. The spacious living room seamlessly flows into the dining area and an open kitchen, complete with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the living spaces with natural light, while a private front balcony showcases stunning views of downtown San Francisco and Twin Peaks. Both bedrooms offer generous closet space and feature sliding doors that open onto a private deck. Additional highlights include two-car tandem parking and a private storage locker. Ideally located just minutes from Diamond Heights Village, Glen Park, Noe Valley, public transit, and freeway access.
